cover_letter_chunks.text: I'm reaching out because your backend data engineering role lines up exactly with the invoicing-pipeline work I've been doing at Capital Ledger Systems, and I'm eager to bring that same focus to a team solving these problems at a larger scale.
What draws me most to this position is the chance to grow from cron-based scheduling into full Apache Airflow orchestration, learning from engineers who have already solved that problem well.
